title: Ecuadorian banana farm with hired labor, falling box prices (English), contrast partner of S2
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): banana hired-labor farm, El Oro, Ecuador, with a packing station upgrade. Same challenge as S2 (market and price) but a different crop, country and entity type: the SYN-007 run for contrast pair C2.

turns.message: The price buyers pay for our banana boxes has dropped this year, and we still have to pay our workers the same wages.
It started after the last contract renewal. We get about a tenth less per box. We upgraded the packing station to reach export grade, but the buyers still pay less.

intake_replies: We are also looking for a second exporter, but the contracts run for a full year.
